subject: FYI: Developing and testing now only on R v2.7.0 (current stable release)

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: FYI: Developing and testing now only on R v2.7.0 (current stable release)
parts:
Hi,

from now on I am doing all developing and testing of aroma.affymetrix
(and friends) on R v2.7.0 (the latest stable release of R). Although
the hard requirement on aroma.affymetrix is only R v2.6.0 (see
DESCRIPTION file), the soft requirement is that you use R v2.7.0. I
will no longer guarantee that things work under R v2.6.x.

Cheers

Henrik
